errors.why: `sem prejuízo de X` is a fixed legal expression meaning X CONTINUES to apply. The concept marks `the absence of the element that follows`, so the normalised output asserts the opposite of the source. I read this occurrence during the sweep, recorded it as a borderline legal idiom, accepted it, and then reported 31/31 correct. Eight of the 31 are this expression.

errors.why: `ativo em X` / `passivo em X` is the leg of a swap — which side receives and which pays — not an item of economic value. precision-amendment-01 demoted `technical.active_management 'ativa'` citing this exact construction and the diagnosis was never propagated to the masculine forms, which are the high-frequency ones.
